purpose: Compare individual collaboration runs under symmetric repetitions and evaluate every committed checkpoint before accepting an instruction change.

targets.note: Freeze task hash, actual model settings, sample plan, quality/cost/latency acceptance and explicit budget before changing status to registered. Per-run rates share tasks and have no independent-binomial confidence interval.

limits: Automatic judges do not constitute human acceptance. Inspect disagreements, safety violations and boundary cases. This draft cannot start a version 3 model run. Historical v2 results retain their original protocol.
